subject: Vendor onboarding: initiation playbook & PO handoff
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <s.ramos@lumentech.com>, LumenTech Procurement <procure@lumentech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor kickoff: what we need from you / what we'll deliver

Hi Sofia — great to be moving this forward. Thanks for the intro earlier. This thread will be our primary lane for procurement onboarding for the upcoming integration. I pulled together a short initiation playbook so we can agree responsibilities and an estimated timeline.

What we need from LumenTech (requested by end of day Aug 24 if possible):
- Signed W9 (PDF) and legal entity name as it appears on tax docs
- US bank details for ACH (bank name, account number, routing — or vendor portal enrollment)
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone) and invoicing cadence (monthly/biweekly)
- Signed countersigned SoW or confirmation of SOW start date and rate card
- Point of contact for technical onboarding and a brief readiness note if you require sandbox access

What Redwood will provide / action items on our side:
- Share our standard vendor onboarding checklist (attached) and Invoice Guide
- Raise a draft PO (we'll send PDF for signature/acceptance) and route for approvals
- Invite your billing contact to our supplier portal (if accepted) and share test invoice instructions
- Procurement contact for any follow-ups: Marissa Cole (cc'd)

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet of required docs & due dates)

Proposed timeline:
- Aug 24: vendor returns W9 + remittance info
- Aug 25: Redwood raises draft PO and routes for signature
- Aug 28: first invoice accepted (target) — depends on PO/portal setup

If any of these dates are tight on your side, tell us which items you can complete first and we'll prioritize the PO creation.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Business Development Manager, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com

- W9 attached: LumenTech Systems, Inc.
- ACH: we'll send bank account/ACH via secure form this afternoon (sensitive info)

- SOW: we received the final SOW on Aug 20 and Sofia (me) will confirm start date once PO is issued

Tentative go-live: Sep 4 — depends on PO and sandbox access. If you can send the PO draft and any onboarding portal link, we'll expedite internal approvals.

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sofia. Confirming receipt of W9 and vendor form. We'll treat ACH details as sensitive and accept via secure link only.

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in to confirm PO timing and any procurement prerequisites from our side. Can you confirm:
- PO will be created as PO_000491 (draft) and routed to LumenTech for acceptance
- Standard terms: Net 30, Redwood prefers ACH but will accept check for first invoice if needed
- Any additional contract signatures required by finance/legal before PO issuance?

Sofia — action items for Redwood (by EOD Aug 24):
1) Send draft PO (PDF) for review
2) Send supplier portal invite & quick test-invoice instructions
3) Attach our Invoice Guide and outline remittance address (attached)

If we can hit these, Sep 4 go-live looks achievable.

Connor
